title: Transactions API
description: The Transactions API lets you retrieve a merchant's card and payment transactions. Fetch a paginated transaction list — optionally narrowed to a date range, store, or terminal — or run a free-text search across a merchant's transactions to reconcile payments, build reporting, or look up an individual sale.

apis.heading: List Transactions
apis.description: Retrieve a paginated list of the authenticated merchant's transactions. Narrow the results to a date range, a single store, or a single terminal. When a start date is given without an end date, a 24-hour window from the start date is used.
apis.query: Page through results with the `x-page-number` request header. The total number of matching transactions is returned in the `x-total-items` response header.

reqParams.name: startDate
reqParams.description: Start of the date range to fetch transactions for (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-06-01). When omitted, results are not date-filtered.

reqParams.name: endDate
reqParams.description: End of the date range. If a startDate is supplied without an endDate, a 24-hour window from startDate is used.

reqParams.name: storeId
reqParams.description: Return only transactions that took place at this store.

reqParams.name: terminalId
reqParams.description: Return only transactions processed by this terminal (checkout).

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The transactions on the current page.

resParams.name: transactionId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the transaction.

resParams.name: merchantId
resParams.description: Identifier of the merchant the transaction belongs to.

resParams.name: storeId
resParams.description: Identifier of the store where the transaction took place.

resParams.name: terminalId
resParams.description: Identifier of the terminal (checkout) that processed the transaction.

resParams.name: orderId
resParams.description: Identifier of the order the transaction settled.

resParams.name: paymentId
resParams.description: Identifier of the payment that produced the transaction.

resParams.name: referenceId
resParams.description: Your own reference, supplied when the payment was created.

resParams.name: rrn
resParams.description: Retrieval reference number assigned by the acquirer.

resParams.name: amount
resParams.description: Transaction amount, in the smallest unit of the currency (e.g. öre for SEK).

resParams.name: currency
resParams.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the transaction.

resParams.name: method
resParams.description: Payment method used, for example CARD, SWISH or GIFT_CARD.

resParams.name: type
resParams.description: Transaction type, for example PURCHASE or RETURN.

resParams.name: orderSummary
resParams.description: Short, human-readable summary of the order.

resParams.name: timestamp
resParams.description: When the transaction was created, in ISO 8601 format.

resParams.name: voided
resParams.description: Whether the transaction was voided.

resParams.name: issuerCountry
resParams.description: Country of the card issuer, reported at settlement.

resParams.name: interchangeDomain
resParams.description: Interchange domain the card falls under, for example domestic or intra-regional.

resParams.name: cardCategory
resParams.description: Card category reported at settlement, for example consumer or commercial.

resParams.name: cardUsage
resParams.description: Card funding type reported at settlement, for example debit or credit.

resParams.name: fee
resParams.description: Surfboard fee charged on the transaction, in the smallest currency unit.

resParams.name: feeVat
resParams.description: VAT charged on the Surfboard fee, in the smallest currency unit.

resParams.name: settlementStatus
resParams.description: Settlement state of the transaction; NOT_SETTLED until it is paid out.

resParams.name: payout
resParams.description: Amount paid out to the merchant for this transaction, in the smallest currency unit.

resParams.name: settlementRef
resParams.description: Reference of the settlement batch the transaction was paid out in.

resParams.name: settlementDate
resParams.description: Date the transaction was paid out to the merchant.

resParams.name: truncatedPan
resParams.description: Last four digits of the card number (PAN), zero-padded to four characters.

resParams.name: cardLabel
resParams.description: Application label of the card scheme used (the AID name).

resParams.name: posEntryMode
resParams.description: How the card was presented at the point of sale (entry mode).

resParams.name: issuerApplication
resParams.description: Issuer application data returned by the card.

resParams.name: terminalVerificationResult
resParams.description: Terminal verification results (TVR) from the card interaction.

resParams.name: aid
resParams.description: Application identifier (AID) of the card scheme used.

resParams.name: customerResponseCode
resParams.description: Response code returned by the card issuer.

resParams.name: cvmMethod
resParams.description: Cardholder verification method code used during the transaction.

resParams.name: cvmMethodDescription
resParams.description: Human-readable description of the cardholder verification method (e.g. 'Online PIN', 'No CVM').

resParams.name: authMode
resParams.description: Authorization mode; ISSUER when the issuer authorized the transaction.

resParams.name: cardBrand
resParams.description: Card brand, for example VISA or MASTERCARD.

resParams.name: authCode
resParams.description: Authorization code returned by the issuer.

resParams.name: adjustments
resParams.description: Tip or amount adjustments applied to the transaction. Present only when adjustments exist.

resParams.name: type
resParams.description: The kind of adjustment, for example TIP.

resParams.name: amount
resParams.description: Adjustment amount, in the smallest currency unit.

resParams.name: adjustmentId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the adjustment.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Search Transactions
apis.description: Run a free-text search across the merchant's transactions — for example by order reference, RRN, or card label — and get back the matching transactions along with the fields that matched and a short snippet for each.

reqParams.name: query
reqParams.description: The text to search the merchant's transactions for, such as an order reference, RRN, or card label.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The search results.

resParams.name: transactionDetails
resParams.description: The matches found for the search.

resParams.name: entries
resParams.description: Total number of matching transactions.

resParams.name: hits
resParams.description: The matching transactions.

resParams.name: transactionId
resParams.description: Identifier of the matching transaction.

resParams.name: path
resParams.description: Location within the transaction where the match was found.

resParams.name: matches
resParams.description: The individual field matches for this transaction.

resParams.name: field
resParams.description: The transaction field that matched the search.

resParams.name: matched
resParams.description: The matched value.

resParams.name: snippet
resParams.description: A snippet of text surrounding the match.

resParams.name: transaction
resParams.description: A normalized view of the matched transaction.
